title: The Fallen Cinderworks
stage: Offline artistic proposal; not gameplay-tested content

placements.story: The once-grand worker entrance still frames the refuge beyond.
Fallen stones mark an older collapsed side entry.
West niche: banking, guidance and a worker ledger.
Recovery and restoration alcove outside the circulation ring.
The old smelting hearth receives ore directly from the haulage court.
A paired casting hearth has cooled to a dull red.
Collapsed maintenance return; future repair shortcut, not a required route.
Coolant drives the wheel before feeding the western pump bank.
The bound furnace is the floor’s visual and industrial destination.
A surviving upper bearing hints at the next floor; no live transition is implemented.
